notes: The draft was tagged Light; the post is a Dark deck (tag '- Dark', Dark objective My Lord, Is That Legal?), so every card is the Dark page.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (5)': My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, We Must Accelerate Our Plans and Begin Landing Your Troops; these count toward the 60. We Must Accelerate Our Plans is a Used Interrupt, not a starting interrupt, so no starting interrupt is set.
The title and strategy call this a Type II deck (Episode I-only environment); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Alter and Control.

Total is 61 as published (section headers add to 59; 'Interrupts (19)' lists 21 cards). In the strategy the author writes 'Change WMAOP to Nemodian Advisor' without saying which copy; the list is kept as published (We Must Accelerate Our Plans, a unique card, appears twice: once in the starting section, once under Interrupts).
Rune Haako is listed twice under 'Other Characters' (two rows kept as published).

Posted 'Lott Dodd' dested Lott Dod; 'Orn Free Ta' dested Orn Free Taa; 'Yeb Yeb Adem' dested Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'Podrace Collision' dested Podracer Collision; 'Nemoidian Advisor' dested Neimoidian Advisor; 'Sebulba's Racer' dested Sebulba's Podracer; 'Drop' dested Drop!; 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine; the strategy says 'Maul (Tat)').
